summary: Prompt-time FILE pointers for the Claude recall hook (embedder step 4). injectSkipReason returns embedder-off / empty / slash-command / few-terms (reducer < 2 terms, e.g. 'go ahead'); otherwise fileInjection spawns `node dist/index.js find <reduced terms, first MAX_TERMS=40> --json --embed-stdin --rerank-budget-ms 800` (4 s timeout) with the full prompt written to the child's stdin, drops vendor rows and TEST_PATH paths (find --json includes tests; TEST_PATH is NOT exported, evals must copy it), and renders the top 3 as `- path — defines …; named for …` plus a one-line gs hint. Its result carries `rerank` (find's rerank field): null means the embedding re-rank did not fire and the pointers are plain keyword order — an eval must check it rather than assume fusion. The reducer keeps every noun of the prompt, so pasted boilerplate (e.g. a benchmark's 'After completing the task, write your answer to …' output-format block) adds ~20 generic terms and lets big generic files win the top 3. A library, not a wired entry point (kb-recall.mjs imports regex-engine first). Measured end to end on coldstart: ~0.7 s warm.
